mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below the 20-year median (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3% annualized) signals imminent central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days due to rising discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3% (annualized) (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicate tight labor conditions, triggering wage inflation and central bank tightening that produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both PAYEMS growth is above 0.5% and UNRATE is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized) signals economic overheating and impending policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day returns as growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansions when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market, generating wage pressures and inflation that eventually cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days as policy responses accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO monthly change < -0.5%) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as growth expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO monthly change falls below -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO monthly change < -0.5%) signal restrictive monetary policy amid economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high rate environments (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), cumulative restrictive monetary policy causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as growth expectations decline and risk premiums rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
